purpose: Document local district/state land-record evidence and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: The district administration directs Berhampore residents to the State land-record portal. Banglarbhumi lists plot-map and mouza-map request services, but those Citizen Services require login; no public vector geometry was verified. The WUP point was not assigned to a local Mouza or ward, so the district/state registry discovery is not treated as exact location coverage.
registryAssessment: Local land-record service pathway exists through the Berhampore SDO and West Bengal portal. No exact parcel/map record was queried.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Murshidabad District administration says citizens access Land & Land Reforms Department services through Banglarbhumi and lists the Berhampore SDO office.
Bengali district page repeats the same official land-service portal and Berhampore location.
State Land & Land Reforms portal lists Plot Map Request, Mouza Map Request and Mouza Map Availability Details; page instructs users to log in before using Citizen Services.
Municipality page lists the civic body’s area/ward context; it did not provide a vector boundary or parcel data used in this review.
West Bengal Planning and Statistics describes state/district GIS administrative layers including Mouza boundaries; it is not a parcel layer.
